tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Latar aplikasi dan canvas editor (elevasi E0).

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panel yang menempel: sidebar, drawer konfigurasi, panel log (E1).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Kartu dan node di canvas (E2).

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Isian hover/pressed, tombol secondary, track toggle off.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menu dropdown, toast, popover (E3), selalu bersama border-strong + shadow-3.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Latar input dan textarea.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Divider di dalam panel, garis antar baris log.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Border kartu, node, dan panel.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border hover kartu, border overlay (menu, toast).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Border input, select, toggle off, port node. >=3:1 di surface-1, surface-2 dan field di kedua tema.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Teks utama di bg dan semua surface (>=13:1 di kedua tema).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Teks sekunder, label, ringkasan config node, di bg dan semua surface (>=6:1).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamp log, placeholder, di bg dan semua surface (>=4.6:1).

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Titik grid canvas (dekoratif, bukan informasi).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Garis koneksi antar node (idle). Aktif memakai accent.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Isian CTA utama (satu per view), toggle on, garis koneksi aktif.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover pada isian accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Link, ikon aktif di nav, teks status running, focus ring; di bg, surface-1/2 dan accent-soft (>=5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Latar tint di balik accent-text (badge running, token {{ }} di expression field).

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Border node yang sedang running, border chip accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Teks dan ikon di atas isian accent (label tombol primary). Gelap di tema dark.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Teks/ikon status running (badge, spinner node). Alias accent-text: sistem sedang bertindak.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: Latar badge running. Alias accent-soft.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Outline fokus keyboard: solid 2px, offset 2px. >=3:1 di bg dan semua surface di kedua tema.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status sukses: teks/ikon di bg, surface dan success-soft (>=5:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Latar badge dan baris sukses.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border node sukses.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Peringatan (retry, rate limit, data parsial): teks/ikon di bg, surface dan warning-soft (>=5:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Latar badge dan callout peringatan.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border callout peringatan.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Gagal/error dan aksi destruktif: teks/ikon di bg, surface dan danger-soft (>=5:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Latar badge gagal, tombol danger.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border node error, input error (dipakai bersama teks danger).

tokens.name: cat-trigger
tokens.usage: Ikon node kategori Trigger (Webhook, Jadwal, Form) di atas cat-trigger-soft.

tokens.name: cat-trigger-soft
tokens.usage: Tile ikon node Trigger.

tokens.name: cat-action
tokens.usage: Ikon node kategori Action (HTTP Request, Email, Sheets) di atas cat-action-soft.

tokens.name: cat-action-soft
tokens.usage: Tile ikon node Action.

tokens.name: cat-control
tokens.usage: Ikon node kategori Control (Kondisi, Loop, Tunggu) di atas cat-control-soft.

tokens.name: cat-control-soft
tokens.usage: Tile ikon node Control.

tokens.name: cat-output
tokens.usage: Ikon node kategori Output (Respond, Simpan, Notifikasi) di atas cat-output-soft.

tokens.name: cat-output-soft
tokens.usage: Tile ikon node Output.

groups.name: Heading
groups.note: Semua heading 600. h1-h3 sedikit dirapatkan. h6 dipakai uppercase (text-transform) sebagai label section.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Judul halaman (Dashboard, Settings). Satu per halaman.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Judul section besar, judul empty state.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Judul grup di drawer, judul dialog.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Label section (uppercase): grup nav, header kolom log.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Teks UI. Plus Jakarta Sans punya spasi kata sempit (0.17em): set word-spacing .05em pada teks UI.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kirim data order ke endpoint toko setiap ada pesanan baru.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Teks padat: baris list, isi drawer, tombol.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label form, label tombol, item nav.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Gunakan {{ }} untuk mengambil data dari node sebelumnya.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Untuk data: expression, JSON, log, timestamp, durasi, ID.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Jarak ikon-ke-dot di badge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Padding menu, gap ikon kecil.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap di dalam komponen (ikon + label).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding horizontal tombol/input, padding node.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding kartu dan panel.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Jarak antar field di form.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding halaman di panel lebar, jarak antar grup.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Jarak antar section halaman.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Padding empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Jarak node horizontal minimum di canvas.

radius.note: Kecil dan konsisten: tombol 6, kartu/node 8, panel 12, badge pill.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Opsi menu, token expression, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tombol, input, select, tile ikon node.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Kartu, node, menu dropdown.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panel besar, toast, empty state.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badge status, toggle, dot.

shadow.note: Elevasi dibangun dari surface + border; shadow hanya penguat. Tanpa blur/glass.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: E2: kartu dan node.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Drawer yang melayang di atas canvas, node saat di-drag.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: E3: menu dropdown, toast, popover.

duration.note: Semua transisi 120-240ms. Tidak ada yang lebih dari 300ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, warna tombol.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Perubahan status badge/node, toggle.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Masuk drawer dan toast. Tidak ada yang lebih lama dari ini kecuali loop indikator running.

easing.note: Satu kurva masuk, satu kurva keluar.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default untuk semua perubahan state dan elemen yang masuk.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elemen yang keluar (toast hilang, drawer tutup).
